versions.content: Pdu routing with IPduMapping . pduMaxLength The attribute IPduMapping . pduMaxLength defines a maximum length which shall be forwarded to the destination module by the PduR, if the runtime length of the actually received Pdu exceeds IPduMapping . pduMaxLength .
